'''Johann Florian Holsboer'''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Johann Florian Holsboer in München |url=https://www.moneyhouse.ch/en/person/holsboer-johann-florian-107924414101 |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=Moneyhouse |language=en}}</ref> (born 27 May 1945) is a German-born Swiss [[professor]], [[physician]] and [[chemist]]. Most notably he has served as the president of  [[Max Planck Society]] from 1989 to 2014 in [[Munich]]. Between 2014 and 2021, he served as executive of ''HMNC Brain Health GmbH'' which he co-founded with [[Carsten Maschmeyer]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bram |first=Arie |date=2021-12-16 |title=Advisor Spotlight: Dr. Florian Holsboer |url=https://polarisgenomics.com/advisor-spotlight-dr-florian-holsboer/ |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=Polaris Genomics |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-11-04 |title=Schweizer Psychiater empfehlen umstrittenen Gentest |url=https://www.bazonline.ch/schweizer-psychiater-empfehlen-umstrittenen-gentest-304933915275 |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=Basler Zeitung |language=de}}</ref>

== Life ==
He is a son of [[Willem Holsboer]], an actor, film and theater director, who was born in Stuttgart to Swiss expatriate parents. His great-grandfather was Dutch-born Swiss [[Willem Jan Holsboer]] who came to Switzerland in 1867, became a Swiss citizen in 1888, and pioneered the tourism industry of [[Davos]] as well as founding [[Rhaetian Railway]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ehrenpromotion 2013 der Medizinischen Fakultät |url=https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/portrait/awards/hc/2013/med-2.html |access-date=2024-09-01 |website=www.uzh.ch |language=de}}</ref>
